prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final Windows desktop application icon for TOUCHLINE, a premium football squad and club editor.
Create one gorgeous, highly legible app icon, square 1024x1024. A single original bold geometric capital T monogram inspired by football pitch touchlines, sculpted in luminous mint/seafoam green (#7FE6CC) on a very dark midnight navy (#101922) rounded-square tile. The T should occupy around 65 percent of the tile width, have thick confident strokes, carefully balanced negative space and softly chamfered corners. Integrate just ONE subtle football pitch marking, a broad half-circle intersecting the lower stem, into the monogram's geometry; keep it immediately readable as T at tiny taskbar sizes. The shape should feel bespoke and precise, like a polished professional creative-tool icon. Mostly flat clean geometry with a restrained satin bevel and faint directional highlight for depth, not shiny plastic or neon. Use high contrast, generous but not excessive padding; tile occupies 92 percent of canvas with rounded corners. Transparent outside the tile, real alpha. Front-facing orthographic, no perspective. No words, no small letters, no badge text, no football club logo, no decorative particles, no grid background, no mockup, no extra symbols, no detached drop shadow, no watermark. One finished icon only, not a sheet of alternatives.
